name: sheet-validator
description: Catch bad data before you import, submit or send a spreadsheet: missing values, duplicate IDs, wrong phone numbers and emails, impossible dates like 2025-13-01, numbers out of range, values outside an allowed list, wrong formats. Write rules in plain lines like “工号: required, unique” — a starting set is suggested from your data — then fix the flagged cells right in the table and export a marked-up Excel and the list of problems. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在导入系统、提交或发出表格之前先把错误数据揪出来：漏填、编号重复、手机号和邮箱写错、2025-13-01 这样不存在的日期、数字超出范围、不在可选值里、格式不对。规则用一行一句的大白话写，比如“工号: required, unique”——打开时会根据数据自动生成一份初始规则——然后直接在表格里改正标出的单元格，导出标注好的 Excel 和问题清单。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
